docs.title: Connect to the Brightpath VPN
docs.body: Open the VPN app, pick the Brightpath office, and sign in with your work account. If the VPN does not connect, restart the app and try again.

I’ve created a ticket for you:

**Ticket ID:** TCK-1006  
**Title:** VPN connection issue from home  
**Description:** You’re unable to connect to the Brightpath VPN from home. Suggested steps: open the VPN app, select the Brightpath office, sign in with your work account, and restart the app if needed. The ticket is now open for further investigation.

If you need any more help while we work on this, just let me know!
